ov: موسم صيد 3 (الإنجليزية: Open Season 3) هو فيلم كوميدي تم إنتاجه في الولايات المتحدة سنة 2010.
plotEn:
One spring morning several years after the events of the second film, Boog awakens after hibernation and plans an annual guys' trip to spend time with his best friends. Family Circus, a Russian traveling show, where he meets Doug—a lazy, self-centered, scruffy grizzly bear who can’t perform tricks and is tired of being sidelined. Doug yearns to be recognized as the king of the forest and tricks Boog into switching places, promising his Argentine camelid best friend and Elliot’s counterpart, Alistair, that he’ll return to bring him to the forest. However, Doug breaks his promise, posing as Boog to enslave the forest animals. Alistair eventually reveals Doug’s scheme to Boog back at the circus. Despite Alistair’s role in the scam, Boog forgives him, and they bond over their shared feelings of abandonment by their best friends.
While in the circus, Boog falls head over heels for Ursa, a Russian-born grizzly who can easily walk a tightrope, juggle, and dance—skills Boog calls “bearvana.” Ursa, already annoyed by Doug’s bad attitude before he left, mistakes Boog for Doug at first and is irritated by his crush. She dares him to prove he’s not Doug by climbing the high wire, which he does, only for her to admit she knew from the start—when he rode a unicycle—that he wasn’t Doug, since Doug couldn’t do that.
